name: Shirudaku Settai Okawari Ippaime ~Kako no Mitsu wa Donna Aji? Hen~
original_name: 汁だく接待おかわり一杯目 ～過去の蜜はどんな味？編～
source:
Nero, who has been a wanted for several years, visits his hometown, and sees his ex-girlfriend, Ikumi, by chance. She is already married and lives a happy life. "What? Is she married?" He decides to take revenge on her....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305035106/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1008054]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
被通缉多年的毒岛音露回到故乡，偶遇前女友泽井郁美。她已经结婚，过着幸福生活。“什么？她结婚了？”音露决定报复她……

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305035106/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1008054]Eroge Shop[/url]]
